crossRefs.note: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and…
Hear me, Yahweh, hear me, that this people may know that you, Yahweh, are God, and that you have turned their heart…
He prayed to him; and he was entreated by him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his…
It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.
You shall seek me, and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
“Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant, and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on…
“I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be…
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.
This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.”
All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore…
It shall happen that from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, all flesh will come to worship…
And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

translations.web: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.
translations.bsb: O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.
translations.kjv: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
